verification.notes: 63,206 char limit is the long-standing documented figure. Meta requires AI-content labeling for synthetic media. Groups are rules-gated communities — group rules apply before platform norms.

maxChars.note: far beyond effective length; keep posts short

links.notes: Preview cards render inline. First-comment link placement is strategy folklore, not a documented rule.

publishing.perCommunityRules: Facebook Groups have admin-enforced rules; many require post approval. The 'groupId' target requires the user to confirm group rules allow the content type.

api.notes: Pages API posts to Pages you manage, not personal profiles. Requires Meta app review for broader scopes.

rateLimit.notes: Group spam controls are admin-configured; pace conservatively.

culture.audience: General public 25-55+, local communities, interest Groups
